name: MidiInput
brief: MIDI device listener with per-note expression and MPE support.
description:
Connects to a MIDI input device and outputs note/velocity/gate as both
scalar signals (latest note) and polyphonic lane arrays (up to 16 held notes).
Also provides pitch bend, mod wheel, a learnable CC value, and per-note
expression lanes (bend, pressure, slide, expression) with three routing modes:
poly_shared broadcasts shared expression to all notes, mpe_lower and mpe_upper
route per-channel expression to individual note lanes for MPE controllers.
tips: Enable learn mode and move a controller to auto-assign the CC number.
Use mpe_lower or mpe_upper mode with an MPE controller for per-note expression.

params.name: mode
params.doc: Expression routing mode: poly_shared (broadcast), mpe_lower (manager ch1, members ch2-15), mpe_upper (manager ch16, members ch15-2).

outputs.name: notes
outputs.doc: Held note numbers as lane array.

outputs.name: lane_ids
outputs.doc: Stable identity token per active note.
